A block-interior comment attaches to the finest following node — the
next statement, the final expr, or the block's own unit node when
nothing follows — and a trailing same-line comment attaches backward
to the node whose line it shares. Attachment is by handle, so the
comment-before-final-expr case never wraps the final as an ExprStmt.
Same-line is token geometry: no TNewline between the item and the
comment; the span comparison failed because a braceless let-chain
leaves the position past consumed newlines, and the str_contains doc
attached to str_compare until the token test caught it at the Lede.

mentl/71feb22:
Supersedes the predicate-only NProgram with the whole-AST form. Every node,
at birth (mint_node), registers its body into a parallel `program` weave
keyed by its handle — so the entire AST is resolvable live by handle
(graph_node_body): one handle indexing two co-indexed weaves, the mutable
union-find type cell in `nodes` and the parse-written program body in
`program`. The night sky — program, types, and rows are one graph any
cursor reads.

- types.mn: NodeKind sheds NProgram (the body is a program-weave entry, not
  a nodes-array cell — distinct discipline, no type/body conflict at the
  shared handle). graph_register_node(Int, NodeBody) -> () registers at a
  handle; graph_node_body reads the weave.
- graph.mn: `program` state weave; graph_register_node is a 4-line list_set
  at the handle (no fresh alloc, no trail — the weave grows only at parse,
  before speculation); graph_node_body indexes it.
- parser.mn: mint_node is the one birthplace — allocate handle, edge-link
  body, wrap. nexpr/nstmt/npat/nhole route through it. The predicate path
  collapses: operands carry their node's existing handle (node_handle),
  registration moved to birth — node_to_predicate/compare_pred go pure,
  register_operand dissolved.
- infer.mn: predicate creators carry node_handle (pure).
- verify/show/cache: unchanged — already resolve via graph_node_body /
  serialize the i32 handle.

Gate-green (seed builds; micros ev2/4/8=57 ev5=21 ev16=18 — the evidence
seam unperturbed by the new graph state field); census 179 (-2: the
generalization is LESS code). The whole AST in the fabric is the foundation
the e-graph (equality saturation as a cursor read over chase-roots + Reason)
and forkable/durable compile build directly on.
mentl/7165bbb:
Closes named peer follow-up. Substrate:

1. driver_collect_dag_with_deps — pairs each post-order module with
   its in-DAG dep names (filtered against the collected set to drop
   missing-module + stdlib aliases that don't contribute to the wait
   condition).

2. driver_partition_layers — peels modules into topological levels.
   Each pass selects the "ready set" (deps all processed); subsequent
   passes peel deeper levels. Cycle / unsatisfiable case folds the
   leftover into a final-layer sequential pass so driver_check_module
   surfaces diagnostics rather than hangs.

3. driver_check — page-topology:
     entry_module
       |> driver_collect_dag_with_deps
       |> driver_partition_layers
       |> for_each((layer) => parallel_map(driver_check_module, layer))

   for_each over layers gates dep-installation (deps must install
   before dependents); parallel_map per layer fans out via `><`
   recursion in lib/runtime/threading.mn. parallel_compose interprets
   each spawn/join across OS threads (cargo-class multi-core); the
   handler swap to sequential_compose runs same-source on one thread.

4. driver_install_qualified_loop — incidental for_each conversion
   while in the file (the loop walked entries with side-effect, the
   substrate-honest form is for_each).

The compile pipeline now expresses cargo-equivalent module-level
parallelism at the verb layer. wheel-side ratio adds `<|`-tipped
substrate; the `><` topology lives inside parallel_map's recursive
binary-fold body (per lib/runtime/threading.mn:199).

mentl/71e0f33:
Major revelations (design surpasses surfaced for approval):

• LBuildEvidence is redundant. Closure record IS evidence record.
  Grow LMakeClosure signature to (Int, LowFn, List, List) —
  handle, fn, captures, ev_slots. Delete LBuildEvidence.
  "Handler IS state" unification: captures and evidence are
  the same kind of slot.

• Inference synthesizes ev_shape derivably (no new storage) — sort
  of body_row \ handled_by_self at emit time. γ approach.

• BodyContext effect (new) provides current_body_captures +
  current_body_evidence + current_handler_stack to emit sites
  that need to compute offsets and resolve poly dispatch.

• Transient evidence record per poly call. Allocated via arena-
  aware EmitMemory. Lifetime matches handler scope (O(1) reclaim
  on arena_ptr reset).

• Handler arm fn_idx globals — every handler arm emitted as a
  first-class WASM function with $<handler>_<op>_idx global.
  Possibly sub-handle H1.1.

• H1 tightly coupled to H3: EffectOpScheme from H3 IS the
  trigger for LEvPerform emission. Without H3, lower can't
  distinguish perform site from regular fn call. Order: H3
  before H1 confirmed.

• PTee evidence DEFERRED. Handler-value typing is C4's deferred
  piece; H1 closes HandleExpr-arms evidence wiring only.

Mentl's evaluation of the surpass: matches DESIGN Ch 4
"handler IS state" ultimate form. Tighter (one concept, one
LIR variant); drops an entire variant from Phase D's substrate
prep.
mentl/71c634e:
The two core handlers now use the canonical handler-state pattern:

graph_handler with nodes=[], ep=0, next=0:
  - graph_fresh_ty: allocates GNode(NFree(ep), reason), bumps next
  - graph_fresh_row: allocates GNode(NRowFree(ep), reason), bumps next
  - graph_bind: occurs check, then set_at + epoch bump
  - graph_bind_row: set_at for row bindings
  - graph_chase: chase_node with depth limit (50)
  - graph_fork: snapshot for module-level isolation

env_handler with entries=[], scopes=[]:
  - env_extend: prepend (name, scheme, reason) triple
  - env_lookup: linear scan over entries
  - env_scope_enter: push len(entries) mark
  - env_scope_exit: truncate entries back to mark
  - env_free_vars: collect all TVars free in current env
    (needed by real Damas-Milner let-generalization in step 4)

Import paths normalized (removed string quotes).
Handler-state pattern: resume(val) with state = new_state
mentl/71fbc43:
Converted ~100 slice(list, 1, len(list)) head-peeling recursions to
index-based iteration across 20 files. Each slice() copied the entire
list — for the checker processing thousands of items, this was the
dominant quadratic cost path.

Also: unbundled checker handler state from single 6-tuple to 6 named
variables (n, s, e, ef, sc, es) for COW compatibility. Separated
runtime/memory.lux from checker path in compile_wasm so VM builtins
(push, len, slice) aren't shadowed by slow Lux implementations.
Switched subst/env/eff_subst from prepend to append+reverse-scan
for COW-compatible mutation.

Root cause of remaining 11GB: Rust VM compiles push() as regular
Call, not CallBuiltin — COW fast path never fires. This resolves
itself when the compiler runs in WASM (Phase H completion).
